mainEntity.name: What is a wrongful death claim in San Diego?

acceptedAnswer.text: A wrongful death claim in San Diego is a legal action brought by surviving family members when a loved one dies due to the negligence, recklessness, or intentional act of another party. This type of claim seeks compensation for losses suffered as a result of the death, such as funeral expenses, medical bills, loss of financial support, and emotional distress. Unlike criminal cases, which aim to punish, a wrongful death claim focuses on monetary damages for the survivors.
